summary: Turn Excel data into clear trends, segment analysis and decision dashboards. Explore the five-day intermediate course and review the outline.
lede: Excel data analytics helps reporting, finance and operations analysts turn spreadsheet data into repeatable answers to business questions. It covers preparing refreshable data with Power Query, calculating and comparing measures with formulas, and segmenting results in PivotTables. Learners also inspect trends and variances and assemble dashboards with context, checks and notes to support routine reporting and review.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who use Excel to analyse operational, financial or service data and need clearer, more repeatable reporting outputs.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of Excel navigation, basic formulas and workbook handling is expected. No programming is required. The course uses Excel features; access to a compatible Excel desktop or web version with Power Query and PivotTables is needed for hands-on practice. Data Analysis ToolPak availability can vary by Excel setup.
